BiblicalUsage: Mispereth came with Zerubbabel, in the list of those who returned: Jeshua, Nehemiah, Azariah, Raamiah, Nahamani, Mordecai, Bilshan, Mispereth, Bigvai, Nehum, Baanah. He is named once, in Nehemiah's copy of the return list.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Mispereth's single verse still counts: his name stands in the list of those who came home, and the return was made of men like him.
RelatedEvents: Cyrus's Decree and Return from Exile
